name: Stanislav Lebedev-Tutu
role: Corporate espionage and data exfiltration — data thief
location: The Lattice — vertical slum built into scaffolding of an unfinished arcology
description:
Stanislav Lebedev-Tutu is athletic and fluid, the kind of body that suggests either dancer or fighter — and in Meridian 88, the distinction is academic. At 25, he has soft features that belie the chrome underneath — people underestimate him once, usually only once. The chrome is visible — cybernetic arm — right, full replacement from shoulder — stronger than organic,  — and he makes no effort to hide it.

He grew up in the Narrows, where the walls are so close together you learn to fight in confined spaces or you learn to lose. He works as a data thief out of The Lattice, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

What Stanislav Lebedev-Tutu lacks in subtlety, he compensates for in thoroughness. No loose ends, no unfinished business, no second chances.

core_fears: Being identified by corporate facial recognition — living off-grid is survival
Being replaced — younger, faster, cheaper runners coming up behind them
Losing control of their own body to a hacker or malfunctioning cyberware
core_desires: Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of Meridian 88
To prove everyone who dismissed them catastrophically wrong
To protect the people in their district who can't protect themselves
coping_mechanisms: Control — micromanages everything within reach to compensate for the chaos everywhere else
Substances — stims to stay sharp, downers to sleep, a careful pharmaceutical tightrope
Planning — responds to chaos by making detailed contingency plans for everything
blind_spots: Cannot recognize when they're being manipulated by someone who genuinely seems to care
Fails to notice when their own behavior mirrors the people they despise
Assumes their skill set is more transferable than it actually is
psychology.secret: Stanislav Lebedev-Tutu has a child in another city, being raised by someone else. Sends Φ2,000 monthly under an alias. Has never visited.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Quiet and precise. Every word is measured. Silence does the heavy lifting.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rapid and dense — information-heavy sentences that demand attention.
verbal_tics: Speaks in clipped fragments when stressed — drops pronouns, articles, pleasantries
Swears in three languages, often in the same sentence
example_lines: "Your firewalls are decorative. Like curtains on a submarine."
"I copy things. The original owners rarely appreciate the compliment."
"Data wants to be free. I just charge a facilitation fee."

story_hooks: A corporate black site Stanislav Lebedev-Tutu once infiltrated is being reopened, and the people inside know his face
A crew member from Stanislav Lebedev-Tutu's past shows up in Meridian 88, carrying old grievances and new chrome
Stanislav Lebedev-Tutu's augmentations begin malfunctioning in the field — sabotage or degradation, and either answer is bad
narrative_function: Stanislav Lebedev-Tutu functions as a connector — his work puts him in contact with multiple factions, classes, and agendas. Stories involving him naturally cross boundaries between districts, tiers, and moral categories.
augmentations: Cybernetic arm — right, full replacement from shoulder — stronger than organic, obvious chrome. Smartgun link in right forearm — interfaces directly with compatible weapons
daily_life: Irregular schedule dictated by contract timing. Between jobs: equipment maintenance, physical training, and the careful management of a reputation that exists entirely through word of mouth. Drinks at establishments where runners gather — not for pleasure, but for market intelligence.
affiliation: Freelance — works the Shelf circuit exclusively

strengths: mechanical aptitude — can repair or modify almost anything
weaknesses: trust issues that limit crew effectiveness

decision_rules: Will take lower-paying jobs from trusted fixers over higher-paying jobs from unknowns
Refuses contracts that require operating inside The Spires — too much surveillance
Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
Always verifies target identity independently before lethal contracts
Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
escalation_ladder: 1. De-escalate — talk first, assess options, buy time
2. Reposition — move to advantage, control sightlines and exits
3. Threaten — make consequences clear without committing to them
5. Lethal force — only when other options are exhausted or time runs out
6. Scorched earth — everything burns, survival takes priority over everything

interpersonal_modes.employers: Guarded respect. They pay, the job gets done. Anything beyond that is liability.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Loyal but reserved. Trusts their competence, withholds personal information by reflex.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Superficially friendly, internally cataloguing exits and weapons. The smile is real; the relaxation isn't.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Predatory focus. Threats are problems, and problems have solutions. The solution is usually kinetic.

stress_responses.low: Becomes more talkative, working through scenarios verbally.
stress_responses.medium: Withdrawal. Conversations become monosyllabic. Focus narrows to the immediate problem.
stress_responses.high: Goes quiet. The silence is not calm — it's the sound of every contingency being evaluated simultaneously.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
Claims not to care about reputation but monitors what people say about them obsessively
Claims to work only for money but regularly takes underpriced jobs that serve personal justice
habits: Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
Carries a specific caliber round as a lucky charm — has never fired it
Wears the same item of clothing for luck — a scarf, a glove, a specific pair of boots
Maintains a dead drop with emergency supplies in three separate districts
breaking_points: Discovering their employer deliberately sent them into a death trap
Their body rejecting their cyberware — chrome rot, immune rejection, the nightmare scenario
Complete isolation — cut off from network, contacts, and purpose simultaneously
